instruction: Cinematic medium shot of an elderly couple dancing in a cozy bedroom. The blonde woman in a white shirt (R2) is on the left with her back to the camera, head turned slightly. The elderly man in a striped shirt (R1) stands on the right, facing forward, looking down warmly at her. His right hand is placed flat on her back, and they hold hands to the side. The background shows a softly blurred bed and doorway. Warm, soft indoor lighting casts a gentle glow over the intimate moment.
